children: UK iodine producer reported record H1 revenue up 7% yr/yr, driven by production growth
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 more than doubled, reflecting improved productivity and cost control
Company produced 29% more crystalline iodine, with stable prices and strong product demand
Company expects H2 2026 crystalline iodine production of 460-485MT
IO#12 plant expected to be commissioned near end of Q3 2026
Iodine spot price expected to remain firm for rest of 2026
PRODUCTION GROWTH - Co produced 29% more crystalline iodine, boosting sales volumes and revenue
COST CONTROL - Improved productivity, milder winter, and lower chemical costs reduced cost of sales by 8%
STRONG DEMAND - Sustained demand for iodine and derivatives supported sales growth
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the specialty chemicals peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Iofina PLC is GBp70.00, about 37.3% above its September 18 closing price of GBp51.00
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
